description: Toast notification stack: one polite live region, queued toasts beyond max, auto-dismiss that pauses on hover/focus, localisable labels

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Screen position for the toast stack (default top-end); centred positions stay centred in RTL

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Default auto-dismiss duration in milliseconds (default 5000; 0 = stay until dismissed). The timer pauses while the pointer is over the stack, focus is inside it, or the page is hidden

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Maximum number of visible toasts (default 5); further toasts queue and appear as others dismiss

attributes.name: data-label-region
attributes.description: Accessible name of the stack; an authored aria-label wins (default "Notifications")

attributes.name: data-label-info
attributes.description: Visually hidden prefix spoken before info messages (default "Info")

attributes.name: data-label-success
attributes.description: Visually hidden prefix spoken before success messages (default "Success")

attributes.name: data-label-warning
attributes.description: Visually hidden prefix spoken before warning messages (default "Warning")

attributes.name: data-label-error
attributes.description: Visually hidden prefix spoken before error messages (default "Error")

events.name: toast-msg:enqueued
events.detail: { message, variant, duration, source, toast, queued }
events.description: Fired (bubbles) on every show() call; queued is true when the toast waits behind max

events.name: toast-msg:show
events.description: Fired (bubbles) when a toast becomes visible

events.name: toast-msg:hide
events.description: Fired (bubbles) when a toast has been removed

properties.name: queue
properties.description: Read-only. Visible then queued toasts; state is 'visible' or 'queued'

methods.name: show(options)
methods.description: Show a toast. options: { message, variant ('info'|'success'|'warning'|'error'), duration, dismissible (default true), action, onAction, source }. Returns the toast element

methods.name: dismiss(toast)
methods.description: Dismiss one toast (also non-dismissible ones) or drop it from the queue

methods.name: dismissAll()
methods.description: Dismiss every visible toast and clear the queue
